title: Object name wrapped in quotes
description:
Layout-quality rule — a layout object name starts and ends with a double quote. Almost always a paste accident; quoted names break name-based references such as GetLayoutObjectAttribute or Go to Object.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Quoted Object Name" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Object names are the anchor for GetLayoutObjectAttribute, Go to Object and script triggers. A name that includes literal quotes almost never matches what scripts look up.
rule.remediation: Rename the object without the surrounding quotes and update any references that relied on the quoted name.
